bays.times: Charging hours are not published in the council's parking fees schedule — see signs at the car park
bays.tariff: Charges are not published in the council's parking fees schedule — leisure centre and green-space car parks sit outside its five town-centre charging structures; check signs on site for any charges
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app, web or phone) or cash at a PayPoint shop; contactless terminals at some sites

bays.restriction: On-street parking bays — 30 minutes free ('park and shop'): opposite 4 to 8
bays.times: First 30 minutes free — a PayByPhone or PayPoint session must still be started. Charging hours and maximum stay are as signed on the bay
bays.tariff: Emissions-based PayByPhone charges, per hour (priced in 30-minute steps; the council's table runs to 5 hours): Band 1 £1.60; Band 2 £2.40; Band 3 £3.20; Band 4 £3.40; Band 5 £3.60; Band 6 £3.80; Band 7 £4.00. Diesel surcharge 40p per hour. Bands: Band 1 (0 g/km), Band 2 (1–75), Band 3 (76–100), Band 4 (101–130), Band 5 (131–170), Band 6 (171–225), Band 7 (226+)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app, web or phone) or cash at a PayPoint shop; contactless terminals at some sites

bays.times: Open 24 hours — charges apply 8am to 6pm Monday to Sunday
bays.tariff: Hourly rate 2: £1.10-£1.94 per hour (CO2 band 1 £1.10 · band 2 £1.40 · band 3 £1.73 · band 4 £1.94; pre-2016 diesel (NOx charge) £1.30-£2.20). Daily rate 3: £5.50-£9.72 per day (CO2 band 1 £5.50 · band 2 £7.02 · band 3 £8.64 · band 4 £9.72; pre-2016 diesel (NOx charge) £6.48-£11.00) Council car park page quotes: 84p to £1.60 per hour depending on emissions.
